verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a Sprinto MCP server. The GraphQL Developer API is only a developer building block, and the compliance-skills repo is an agent skills package installed via 'npx skills add', not an MCP server, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
